verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI lets you set context length per model load (`--context-length`), control GPU offload (`--gpu`) and name loaded instances (`--identifier`), so a power-user can size context memory for each instance. However, the evidence never explicitly documents running several instances at once or managing how context memory is shared among them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of concurrent multi-instance loading, controls for KV-cache or context memory across simultaneous instances, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
